title: fumaria parviflora var. indica
intro: Fumaria parviflora var. indica, commonly known as Indian Fumitory, is a flowering plant species in the Fumaria genus, which is known for its medicinal properties. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Indian Fumitory include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions such as asthma, bronchitis, and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
